evidence_boundary: Portfolio sensitivity diagnostic only. This is not sponsor-approved MNAR multiple imputation, reference-based imputation or a regulatory tipping-point analysis.

tipping_definition.significance_note: Primary Week 24 MMRM contrasts are already non-significant at delta=0, so loss-of-significance tipping is not a meaningful primary threshold.
